pages.text: Using the $(9)Album Jukebox$(), you can play 9 Music Disc in turn. It has buttons $(o)Last$() and $(o)Next$() to select a specific Music Disc. The currently playing Music Disc is highlighted in yellow.
The add-on adds the interaction of $(9)Jukebox$() with $(9)hoppers$(), as on $(o)Bedrock$(). By the way, it also accepts your personal tracks.
pages.title: Album Jukebox
Minecart with Jukebox
pages.text: Now you won't be bored on a long minecart ride.

Thanks to the $(9)Note Block$(), a villager gets a new profession - a bard. You can sell Music Disc to him, buy blocks from this supplement, Blank Music Disc, Misic Labels and blocks for the music block.
